interview_participants.name: Stella Garber
interview_participants.transcript_contribution: Offsites build trust and psychological safety; remote does not mean rejecting face time

interview_participants.name: William Chia
interview_participants.transcript_contribution: Remote versus in-person is a false dichotomy; effective remote work requires face-to-face time

interview_participants.name: Meryl Johnston
interview_participants.transcript_contribution: Remote-first teams can value face-to-face relationships; retreat organizers should handle details while leaders shape goals and culture

interview_participants.name: Jared Kleinert
interview_participants.transcript_contribution: Offsites can build culture or become a box-checking perk; gathering design should start with goals, environment, facilitation, and invitees

interview_participants.name: Jesse Schoberg
interview_participants.transcript_contribution: The value of gathering comes from the extra moments around work and a changed headspace

interview_participants.name: Branca Ballot
interview_participants.transcript_contribution: Small in-person groups can gather around one difficult customer problem for deeper exploration

interview_participants.name: Scott Brills
interview_participants.transcript_contribution: Prospective retreat operators should run the trip first with forgiving participants

interview_participants.name: Amar Ghose
interview_participants.transcript_contribution: Off-topic water-cooler questions and team retreats support informal connection

interview_participants.name: Barrett Brooks
interview_participants.transcript_contribution: Creating space and rest helps people return without feeling overwhelmed

unbundled_office_framework.description: Eliminate commute, fixed office attendance, and routine co-location
Keep meetings, email, Slack, and project management
Name trust, relationships, context, and serendipity
Use temporary gatherings for the valuable functions
Set goals, environment, facilitation, invitees, and ownership
End the gathering and resume remote work
